reason: Both are diversified, engineered industrial manufacturers that sell to OEMs and end users and supply aerospace and defense components. Crane's Aerospace & Advanced Technologies segment (sensors, connectors) overlaps with AMETEK's aerospace and defense sensors and electromechanical products. Crane's other material business is Process Flow (valves, pumps, flow control). AMETEK's evidence shows instruments, test and measurement, and motion control, not valves or pumps. AMETEK therefore matches only one of Crane's two main businesses, which caps the grade at 1. Customers overlap in aerospace, defense, energy and process industries, but AMETEK also sells heavily into medical, research and semiconductor markets.
